statement.text: Given $k \geq 3$ and a monomial $x^a y^b$ of degree $a+b=kd$, it is known that $\operatorname{rk}_k(x^{a}y^{b}) \leq \max(s,t)+1$, where $s$ and $t$ are the remainders of the division of $a$ and $b$ by $k$, see . Is it true that the latter inequality is, in fact, an equality?

title: Algebraic Stories — The $k$-rank of monomials
